headline: Abatement totals for September 2026, plus executive session on Appellate Tax Board cases and personal exemptions.
summary: The agenda lists September 2026 abatement totals for real estate, excise, and personal property. It also includes executive sessions on Appellate Tax Board cases and on personal exemptions.
items: Executive session on Appellate Tax Board litigation strategy for seven listed matters
Executive session on FY 2026 real estate tax abatements and personal exemptions
location: City Hall – Room 205, 36 Court Street, Springfield, MA
plain_text:
Board of Assessors 
        36 Court Street 
     Springfield, MA 01103 
 
 
    
Regular Meeting – Wednesday November 18, 2026 10:00 AM City Hall – Room 205  
~Agenda~        Jessica Guerra - Chair 
413-886-5256 
 
 
I. Call to Order 
10:00 AM Meeting called to order on November 18, 2026 at City Hall – Room 205, 36 Court Street, Springfield, MA. 
 
 
II. Public Portion 
 
A. Meeting Minutes 
• Public Meeting Minutes 11/4/2026 and 11/6/2026 
 
B. Monthly Abatement Totals 
a. Real Estate Abatements 
• September 2026 Abatement Total = $2,245.65 
b. Excise Abatements 
• September 2026 Abatement Total = $18,158.79 
c. Personal Property Abatements 
• September 2026 Abatement Total = $29,663.03 
 
 
III. Executive Session 
The Board will vote to enter into Executive Session for the following reasons: 
 
1. ATB Docket Review 
  
Pursuant to M.G.L.ch 30A, section 21(3) the Board will enter into executive session to discuss the litigation strategy of matters currently 
scheduled at the Appellate Tax Board.  Discussion of these matters in an open public session will have a detrimental effect on the Board’s 
litigation strategy.  
 
2. FY 2026 Real Estate Tax Abatements and Personal Exemptions 
Pursuant to M.G.L.ch 30A, section 21(7) and M.G.L.ch 59, section 60 and M.G.L.c. 59, section 5, the Board will enter into executive 
session to discuss personal exemptions.
C. Meeting Minutes 
• Executive Session Meeting Minutes 11/4/2026 and 11/6/2026 
 
 
 
D. ATB Docket Review 
 
The Board will enter into executive session and will not return to a public session for the following
